name: Magson Retail & Distribution Ltd.
summary: Magson Retail & Distribution Ltd. is engaged in the retail and distribution of gourmet, specialty, and frozen food products. The company operates a chain of retail stores under its flagship brand "MagSon", and also through specific brands like "Goan Bakery," "Nastabazar," and "My Chocolate World" for chocolates. Their product offerings include a wide array of items such as vegetarian and non-vegetarian frozen snacks, exotic fruits, imported chocolates, dairy, meat, seafood, fresh produce, beverages, and confectionery. Magson Retail & Distribution Ltd. also functions as a B2B distributor, supplying other retailers and clients in the hotel, restaurant, and cafe sectors. The company primarily targets health-conscious and affluent consumers in India, with retail operations across states including Gujarat, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Goa. They also maintain an e-commerce presence through a mobile application.
